includes: This is not included in your tour price.
What is included in the tour price?
This includes expert guidance from our knowledgeable guides, who will lead you through Sugar Pine Point State Park’s beautiful trails.
We provide all necessary equipment—cross-country skis, boots, and poles—so you can focus on enjoying the journey without worrying about gear.
The tour fee also includes parking and land use fees for Sugar Pine Point State Park, helping to keep the park’s trails groomed, and parking lot plowed all winter long!
If your group includes small children or individuals with physical limitations, we recommend booking a private tour for a more customized and comfortable experience.
This may include allowing extra time in the morning to shovel out your car and driveway on heavy snowfall days.
The price of your private tour includes everything needed for an unforgettable cross-country skiing experience.
All necessary equipment—cross-country skis, boots, and poles—is provided, allowing you to fully immerse in the adventure without worrying about gear.

Whether your group includes small children, individuals with physical limitations, or skiers at different fitness levels, we’ll create a customized, enjoyable adventure that meets everyone’s abilities.
